TITLE: Jester Totem
CREDIT: Original Strobe interpretation of a hand-painted blacklight panel
DESCRIPTION: A fluorescent jack-in-the-box totem painted on a dark plank. A horned, one-eyed jester with star eyes, a striped party hat and a grinning zigzag mouth rides a lightning bolt, an orange die and a starburst on a coiled spring that rises from a cranked die. The spring is a real damped spring: bass lifts the jester, kicks and the pop button launch it, and it stretches going up, squashes coming down, bounces and settles. A fan of UV rays turns behind it and flares on kicks, and two smaller twins ride the next planks out. The head and horns sway, the star eyes and the sunburst spin, the third eye blinks and looks around, the crank turns, the bolt flickers with the highs, and sparkles, crosses and stars drift up the outer planks. Procedural, no reference media.

CONTROLS.NAME: pop
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Launch the jester now, on any beat.

CONTROLS.NAME: twins
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Two smaller jesters on the next planks out; fades in and out.

CONTROLS.NAME: rays
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The fan of UV rays behind the jester, which flares on kicks.

CONTROLS.NAME: kick_flash
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How hard the whole panel brightens on a kick.

CONTROLS.NAME: speed
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How fast everything sways, spins and drifts.

CONTROLS.NAME: bounce
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How far the bass and kicks throw the jester, and how much it stretches.

CONTROLS.NAME: wobble
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How much the head, horns and spring sway.

CONTROLS.NAME: spin
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How fast the eyes, sunburst, crank, rays and sparkles turn.

CONTROLS.NAME: zoom
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Closer to the jester, or further out to show more planks.

CONTROLS.NAME: sparkles
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How many sparkles, crosses and stars drift up the outer planks.

CONTROLS.NAME: lightning
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How bright the bolt under the jester flickers with the highs.

CONTROLS.NAME: hue
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Turn every ink round the colour wheel.

CONTROLS.NAME: hue_cycle
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Keep the inks turning round the colour wheel, slowly.

CONTROLS.NAME: glow
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The fluorescent halo round the paint.

CONTROLS.NAME: blacklight
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: The violet cast of the UV on the wood.

CONTROLS.NAME: grain
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How much wood grain shows in the planks and the paint.

CONTROLS.NAME: reactivity
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: How much the music drives all of it.
